strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for a liquidity grab: price sweeps support or resistance, fakes out, and then you enter at the candle that made the grab. The direction depends on the grab: buy-side liquidity grab for shorts, sell-side liquidity grab for longs.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at the recent opposite swing high/low. The video also frames the trade as a reversal play with a small loss and a large impulse move in the target direction.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter at the candle that made the resistance liquidity grab
variants.target_note: take profit at a recent low
variants.transcript_quote: your short entry would be at the bottom of this candle that initiated this liquidity grab

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: enter at the candle that made the support liquidity grab
variants.target_note: take profit at a recent high
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal_with_divergence_confluence
strategies.entry_summary: Trade the same liquidity-grab reversal only when it also lines up with momentum divergence: on a bullish reversal, price makes lower lows while momentum makes higher highs, and the opposite for bearish cases implied by the same confluence logic.
strategies.exit_summary: Use the same stop beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at the recent swing high/low, but the divergence is added as a confluence to improve the odds rather than to change the exit.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: requires divergence on the oscillator alongside the liquidity grab
variants.target_note: same recent high/low take-profit logic as the base setup
variants.transcript_quote: we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability of working in our favor

strategies.name: higher_timeframe_support_resistance_filtered_liquidity_grab
strategies.entry_summary: Take the liquidity-grab reversal only when the lower-timeframe signal occurs at a higher-timeframe support or resistance level. The video uses a 15-minute signal that aligns with a 1-hour support/demand zone as the valid example.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage it with the same normal liquidity-grab stop loss beyond the sweep and target at the recent high/low; the added higher-timeframe context is a filter, not a different exit.

variants.variant_label: lower-timeframe reversal aligned with higher-timeframe level
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: require the signal to occur at higher-timeframe support or resistance before entering
variants.target_note: normal stop loss and take profit from the base liquidity-grab setup
variants.transcript_quote: we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame

result.enumeration_note: One base liquidity-grab reversal is taught, then two compatible filter variants are added: divergence confluence and higher-timeframe support/resistance alignment.
